assets.alt: A rigid branching route tree passes through a compiler threshold and becomes a wall of translucent selector maps, ending at a pinned immutable document.
assets.longDescription: Editorial concept art explaining the architectural transition. It is not a screenshot or benchmark result. Dark nested route branches at left converge at a narrow boundary, then fan into translucent coordinate planes with sparse colored selector sheets and one resolution pin above a document stack.

assets.alt: Three bays contrast dense intersecting selector planes, a sparse field condensed into five document classes, and a structural document with one replaced hero and one tombstone.
assets.longDescription: Editorial triptych for the three scenarios. The dense bay emphasizes overlapping planes, the sparse bay emphasizes a vast field and five reusable outcomes, and the structural bay keeps most placement cards unchanged while one card changes form and another becomes translucent.

assets.alt: Translucent authoring layers flatten into an immutable document while one pointer moves to a new publication and the prior document remains intact for rollback.
assets.longDescription: Editorial publication concept. Separate authoring planes pass through a narrow compiler boundary into two complete immutable document cards. A single green pointer moves from the retained prior card to the new card.
